newsitem.title: HONG KONG: HK bourse mulls changes in listing fee payment.
newsitem.headline: HK bourse mulls changes in listing fee payment.

text.p: The Stock Exchange of Hong Kong said in a statement on Thursday it is considering amendment proposals which require listing fees of debt and derivative securities to be paid in one single lump sum upfront in advance.

The changes, meant to reduce the administrative burden imposed on listed issuers and the exchange by the present procedure in which fees are payable quarterly in advance, are intended to become effective next January 1, the statement said. After a recent review, the exchange concluded the existing fee structure and billing method for listing fees of debt and derivative securities should be revised, it said.
